learning_outcomes: Develop code for multi-core CPUs and many-core GPU processors with attention to detail at multiple levels.
Design and implement parallel algorithms from serial code building blocks.
Perform serial code performance analysis and optimization.
Design, debug, and optimize shared-memory parallel code on multi-core CPUs using OpenMP.
Design, debug, and optimize shared-memory parallel code on many-core GPUs using CUDA and OpenMP device offload.
Design, debug, and optimize distributed-memory parallel code on modern heterogeneous HPC systems using MPI and hybrid parallelism.
Gain familiarity with Partitioned Global Address Space (PGAS) languages such as Unified Parallel C (UPC).
Cultivate technical writing skills through technical reports describing problem, approach, implementation, and results.
Cultivate oral presentation skills through technical paper style presentations on coding assignments and semester project.
Complete a significant semester project involving self-study, parallelization, performance analysis, and technical presentation.
topics: Basics of multiprocessor systems such as clusters and graphics processors
Message-passing and shared memory-based software development
Serial code performance measurement and optimization

skills.evidence: Use performance measurement tools to study performance, including strong- and weak-scaling characteristics. Develop familiarity with multiple approaches for writing shared-memory parallel code primarily in OpenMP.
This part of the course will focus on the unique architecture of many-core GPUs, along with common approaches for writing code for them: CUDA (for NVIDIA-based GPUs)...
Students will become familiar with the Message Passing Interface (MPI), which is the industry standard for developing distributed memory parallel codes...
As an alternative to MPI-based approaches, students will be exposed to Partitioned Global Address Space (PGAS) languages such as Unified Parallel C (UPC).

Working with multiple serial codes on multiple CPU-based platforms, learn best practices in performance measurement in studying code performance behavior and implementing code optimizations to improve performance.
Students will generate a technical report describing the problem being solved, the approach and implementation, and a results section... implemented in LaTeX using a provided template.
For each of the coding assignments, students will give a brief oral presentation describing the problem being solved, their implementation, and results of the performance study.
Use performance measurement tools to study performance, including strong- and weak-scaling characteristics.
Students will become familiar with the concept of “hybrid parallelism” that is a blend of both distributed-memory parallel using MPI and shared-memory parallel using, e.g., OpenMP.
